notes: The author says dinosaur roleplay outright and the player inhabits a creature rather than a person, which is the genre's Animal Sim subgenre; the explicit ban on combat, quests, shops, hunger and progression rules out every genre that would have contended. Shape is wilderness-open because an animal sim has no settlement — a compact prehistoric biome of terrain, rocks, trees and water that players live in, which is what the author described at roughly 250 to 300 studs, and it costs nothing beyond P0. Animal Sim is kept intact: social-hub becomes the open clearing where the several players sharing the map gather rather than a town square, landmark-focal a rock formation that makes a compact map readable, and den-shelter the hollow the rest and sleep animation implies. Without a user I let the shallow water ride on the shape, whose own description already includes water, rather than taking the water-body option, because nothing swims here — there is no swim animation — so the build needs no volumetric CHECK.
